atomic_cutover: The carelifecycle and careexitview legacy packages are deleted in one PR together with every caller. The student-document repository adapter in database/repositories/users was reachable only from its own tests once the lifecycle moved to Care Plan, so the adapter and its test are deleted and the ten document tests run against Care Plan's record capability in modules/careplan/contracttest. That deleted external test was the only importer of models/documents from database/repositories/users, which retires the listed key. No statement and no second provider is added.
